messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate something about hypothesis testing? They mention sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, null hypothesis mean 98.6. They ask to compute the standard deviation? Actually they say "零假設檢定的標準差" which might refer to the standard error or the standard deviation of the sampling distribution under null? They want to compute the standard deviation of the sampling distribution? That would be sample_std_dev / sqrt(sample_size) = 1.4 / sqrt(40). Let's compute: sqrt(40)=6.3249; 1.4/6.3249=0.2213. So standard error ~0.221. But maybe they want to compute the p-value? The question: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" It seems they want to compute the standard deviation of the sampling distribution (standard error). So answer: 0.221. Or maybe they want to compute the p-value? The phrase "以得到人口平均值為98.6" means "to get population mean 98.6". They might want to compute the p-value for a one-sample t-test with null mean 98.6. So we can compute t-statistic: (98.2 - 98.6)/SE = (-0.4)/0.2213 = -1.807. Degrees of freedom df=39. Then p-value two-tailed: 2*P(T <= -1.807). Using t-distribution table approximate p ~ 0.08? Let's approximate: For df=39, t=1.68 gives p=0.10; t=1.88 gives p=0.07. So p ~ 0.07. So p-value ~0.07. But the user didn't explicitly ask for p-value. They asked "計算...的標準差". So likely they want SE. So answer: 0.221. Provide explanation.
